thread:
olivia: Heads-up from webinar ops  — several webinar signups show as unowned in Salesforce after the HS->SF sync. Not HubSpot round-robin this time, looks like SF rejecting owner due to validation.
sam: ugh. Any example lead ids or the validation error?
olivia: pasted the sync log for one email below (trimmed):
```
[1788889999] HS->SF sync attempt lead=wb-2026-19 email=jane@example.com
[1788890001] SF response 400
{ "errors": [{ "status": "400", "message": "OwnerId: owner not active in account" }] }
[1788890002] HS mapping tried to set owner=null and persisted
```
gareth: so SF validation rules are blocking non-active owners and our mapping logic nulls the owner instead of falling back to RR. That would make dashboard show unowned > SLA.
mike: is this only for webinar leads or all sources?
olivia: initial sample shows mostly webinar because we hand off to a prepopulated owner from the webinar form (cached owner). If that cached owner was deactivated in SF, sync fails.
salesops-bot: alert created: salesops/unowned_leads spike at 2024-11-03T10:08:22Z.
tasha: quick mitigation: change HS->SF sync to try apply owner, if SF returns Owner validation error then retry with round-robin assignment in HS before persisting. Minimal change in sync pipeline.
gareth: agree. Also we should patch the webinar form template so it doesn't bake in owner ids; instead write owner_hint and let HS RR pick.
olivia: +1. For immediate fix, can we add a two-step fallback in the sync process? 1) attempt SF owner upsert; 2) if SF rejects owner validation -> call HS assign_round_robin() and push updated owner to SF.
mike: timeline? We need this before next webinar in 12h. Can we hotfix a middleware change that intercepts the SF 400 and triggers an assign?
sam: I can take the middleware hotfix. Plan: add handler to pipeline that interprets SF 400 OwnerId validation errors and makes a blocking retry to HS assign (synchronous) for up to 1s. If assign returns owner, reattempt SF upsert once. If still fail, escalate to SalesOps queue.
tasha: please add metric tags: source=webinar, path=sf-owner-validation, outcome={reassigned, failed}. Set alert if failed rate > 0.5% of webinar leads.
olivia: also update runbook: SDRs should refresh their unassigned queue if they see a spike and notify #salesops. Include troubleshooting steps: check SF user active flag, check HS cached-owner TTL, run reassignment script.
gareth: we should also audit recently deactivated SF users and clear stale owner hints from templates to prevent recurrence. I'll run a one-off job to scan owner_hints created in last 90 days.
sam: hotfix PR incoming in 20m. I'll add smoke test that simulates SF 400 with owner_invalid and assert owner assigned in HS within 2s and SF upsert retried.
olivia: thanks. Can we do a brief canary with one webinar segment first? If green, roll to main.
tasha: agreed. Canary: US-east webinar queue only for 2h, monitor salesops/unowned_leads and outcome metrics.
salesops-bot: noted canary scheduled: 2h window starting 2024-11-03T12:00:00Z.
mike: perfect. tagging this for follow-up in ops standup. :thumbsup:
